name: Alien Life Core
description:
Breacher Primus's core.
There is no way to exterminate this life form. One reduced to nothing but its core will resurrect the next day or in decades. Luckily, it is neither aggressive nor intelligent, so Fontainians can just keep their distance.
fullDescription: The core left behind by a Breacher Primus.\nThere is no way to exterminate this life form. One reduced to nothing but its core will resurrect the next day or in decades. Luckily, it is neither aggressive nor intelligent, so Fontainians can just keep their distance.\nAccording to the Marechaussee Hunter who accompanied the White Cavalier of Protection, countless Breacher Primus emerged after the horrible battle in Elynas, but none assaulted the two.
